title: WP3 state v2/migration and WP4 API v1 gate
head: 523c189 merge(wp3): state format v2 and gated migration
scope: WP3: state format v2 gate, sharded derived families, single-commit migration with online backup, event timeline, bounded request-ledger cleanup. WP4: /v1 HTTP contract with error envelope, idempotency keys, bearer auth, access log, gated inspect. Gates G2/G3 are NOT passed (G2 needs WP5, G3 needs WP6).

results.details: 302/302 tests, 0 failed, 0 skipped (server 292 + scripts 10); clean build included
15/15 WP4 contract tests incl. 5 concurrent same-key writes and the 11-write guard matrix

results.command: node --test state-gate.test.js state-migration.test.js state-events.test.js state-cleanup.test.js profile-concurrency.test.js
openspec validate state-v2-migration --strict && openspec validate api-v1-contract --strict

independentVerification.wp4: 18/18 checks via real startServer + real openRuntime/SQLite + raw TCP socket (413 without buffering, replay byte-identical incl. after restart, log redaction, /inspect gating, auth fail-closed)
independentVerification.wp4Guards: 5 concurrent same-key writes produce one durable effect; all 11 write operations reject missing key with zero writes and return 409 on conflicting payload
independentVerification.wp3: 21/21 checks via independently synthesized v1 fixture (unknown/attempting operations plus six receipt families), real migrateRuntime/openRuntime: semantic equivalence, single commit, idempotent re-run, SIGKILL before/after commit, restored backup, zero-write gates, read-only guard, cleanup protection under injected concurrent change, events not a source of truth

independentAudit.wp3: docs/team/reviews/wp3-state-v2.md - 1 blocker (profile cap used stale pre-commit count) raised; fixed and re-verified

closedBlockers: profile MAX_PROFILE_ENTRIES exceeded under concurrent remember (63 -> 65); counting moved inside the commit
migrateRuntime reported already-migrated on engine/instanceId mismatch; now MIGRATION_INCOMPATIBLE with zero writes
cleanup protection evaluated outside the delete commit; re-validated inside the commit
cleanup dryRun listed protected receipts; preview now equals the real removable set
unverified: v1 semantic-equivalence fixture is SDK-token synthesized, not generated by real v1 product commands; dirty legacy data uncovered
backup-failure branch is code-reviewed only; backup retention and old-backup cleanup not implemented
cleanup default 30-day window, keepCount newest window, 1000-per-run cap and large-batch paging not stress-tested
real large-database migration duration, online backup disk peak and event volume not benchmarked (WP9)
single-process only: migration requires a stopped-writer window and the directory owner lock; no multi-process or online hot migration
read-only mode is a product-level commit/resume guard; SQLite/WAL may still write files, not an OS-level read-only mount
SIGKILL uses deterministic beforeCommit/afterCommit hooks, not instruction-level random kills, power loss or disk-full
profile cap concurrency verified only for two concurrent callers in one event loop
events are partially rebuildable: rebuildEvents() only rebuilds current-state snapshots, not historical transitions
cleanup concurrent-change injection is a deterministic single commit, not randomized interleaving stress
WP4: cross-process concurrency, HTTPS termination/reverse proxy, rate limiting/audit retention, real model or external adapter end-to-end
one transient failure was observed once during a concurrent worktree run and did not reproduce (287/287 on re-run); timing sensitivity under load is not eliminated
notes: Credentials, bodies and provider responses are never persisted by these layers. G2 and G3 remain unpassed by design; this evidence covers the WP3 and WP4 work packages only.
